address: 10 Commerce Street, Auckland Central, Auckland, 1010, New Zealand
bio: Olive green velvet banquettes contrast nicely with the dark wood panelling. Full length picture windows fill the space with natural light, while a double-height wine cabinet catches the eye. Italian classics define the menu. Start with their baked-to-order garlic bread. For primo, try house-made pasta like Bolognese Bianca – cavatelli in a rich, creamy white wine meat sauce. And there’s no better way to end a meal here than an iconic tiramisu.
